vision_mappings.requirement: Durable state owns continuity while models provide bounded semantic judgments.
evidence_needs: Restart and compaction restore the exact accepted boundary and next admissible action.
Semantic judgments remain sourced records while deterministic transitions replay without a model.

vision_mappings.requirement: Owner charter, StrategicPlan, Lowering, and packet or client projections retain explicit authority and lineage.
evidence_needs: Editing a derived projection cannot mutate intent or live strategy.
Strategy remains inspectable after repeated lowering and rerendering.

vision_mappings.requirement: Lowering is checked, lossless, scoped, and distinct from pure capability rendering.
evidence_needs: Coverage catches missing obligation, verification, integration, deferral, and stage-debt dispositions.
Pure rerender preserves meaning without a new economics decision; meaning changes cannot use that route.

vision_mappings.requirement: Senior, Middle, and Junior responsibilities remain separate from capability and trusted authority.
evidence_needs: Desired and resolved profiles are independently visible.
A producer cannot accept its own candidate even when one model fills several roles.
Senior production writes are refused by role capability.

vision_mappings.requirement: Token economics, quiet packets, progressive disclosure, and content reuse begin before dispatch.
evidence_needs: Ordinary worker packet excludes full boot while declaring all omitted or unavailable context.
Mandatory context overflow fails, retrieves, splits, or reroutes instead of truncating.

vision_mappings.requirement: Abstraction is typed, reversible, consumer-checked, and never hides material constraints.
evidence_needs: Fixture preserves invariant and mapping through abstraction and reconstruction.
Unsafe authority or migration abstraction is refused.

vision_mappings.requirement: Material strategic forks preserve alternatives, recommendations, authority, and encounter outcomes without becoming work.
evidence_needs: Prepared branch selection is admitted only under current preconditions and delegated authority.
Unknown branch condition yields evidence request and approach history survives switching.

vision_mappings.requirement: Strong planning and weak offline execution exchange bounded, lineage-preserving bundles and encounter journals.
evidence_needs: Offline export and stale-aware return import preserve identities, failures, candidates, omissions, and unresolved choices.
Simulated weak evidence is labeled and no credential crosses the bundle boundary.

vision_mappings.requirement: One bounded algorithmic service supports agents and clients with truthful completeness and structured errors.
evidence_needs: Bounded lookup, dependency, frontier, why, packet, and resume queries expose revision, scope, completeness, and continuation.
No query calls a model for deterministic navigation.

vision_mappings.requirement: Independent work proceeds concurrently while one fenced controller serializes semantic admission.
evidence_needs: Two independent jobs progress while one waits.
Write or resource conflicts and stale controller epochs are refused.
Review capacity limits outstanding candidates.

vision_mappings.requirement: Owner-selected native subagents are the default transport through a durable AgentHost bridge.
evidence_needs: DispatchIntent, actual native invocation, ExternalJobHandle, receipt, collection, and safe stop are distinguished.
Unavailable native support never silently falls back to a launcher or subprocess.

vision_mappings.requirement: Packets and agent messages have exact lineage, compact typed states, idempotency, and repair behavior.
evidence_needs: Rerender, supersession, retry, malformed response repair, and duplicate delivery preserve useful work and causal lineage.
Heartbeat, checkpoint, transport completion, verification, acceptance, and safe state remain distinct.

vision_mappings.requirement: Compaction, crash, quota, process, and account loss recover from durable state without duplicating effects.
evidence_needs: Crash between dispatch intent and receipt produces reconciliation rather than duplicate launch.
Resume reconstructs relevant decisions, holds, attempts, sources, and next action without hidden reasoning.

vision_mappings.requirement: GOAL.md and scoped worker goals are deterministic reinforcement with actual, manual, and unavailable application states.
evidence_needs: Capability cache invalidates on effective environment change.
Manual Owner-only application emits one exact instruction.
Unsupported goal capability does not claim application or weaken packet enforcement.

vision_mappings.requirement: Dreamer exploration stays detached; grill state persists; exact live promotion or removal preserves authority and obligations.
evidence_needs: Hypothetical edits leave live revision, frontier, approvals, and holds unchanged.
Stale promotion reconciles concurrent change.
Goal removal preserves obligation, evidence, debt, consumer, and external-effect dispositions.

vision_mappings.requirement: Adaptation, nonmonotonic uncertainty, value, incremental economics, scoped holds, and whole-campaign stops form one loop.
evidence_needs: Exactly four hours remains automatic when otherwise eligible; above four requires exact Owner decision.
Cumulative forecasts prevent split allowances.
Affected hold permits proved-independent work while general stop drains the whole campaign.

vision_mappings.requirement: One supported service boundary enforces authority, transitions, holds, stage duties, evidence, effects, and closure.
evidence_needs: Direct close and scheduler share one blocker result including pending selected economics.
Unsupported raw mutation cannot become accepted state.
No OS-isolation claim exceeds the actual boundary.

vision_mappings.requirement: Production is Rust with transactional canonical history, typed reducers, mandatory indexes, cold-trust modes, and measured scale.
evidence_needs: One transaction commits LogicalEvent, receipt, Revision and Sequence, and required index mutations.
Cold trusted reopen and distrustful derivation have explicit verified boundaries.
Installed commands have no production Python dependency.

vision_mappings.requirement: The installed package works in an ordinary VibeVM project without source-checkout, provider, account, or platform assumptions.
evidence_needs: Clean install and operation in a separate small VibeVM project uses only shipped sources and declared dependencies.
Offline and container adapters do not require GitHub or host-repository paths.

vision_mappings.requirement: Every material state and diagnostic needed by agents and the future canvas has a versioned truthful machine view.
evidence_needs: Machine queries expose strategy, lowering, debt, fog, proof, packets, omissions, runtime, economics, holds, stops, and reasons.
Viewer reads perform no semantic model call and cursor gaps remain explicit.

vision_mappings.requirement: Verification is selected by affected guarantees and evidence applicability; full panels remain exceptional.
evidence_needs: Scoped checks include material negative, recovery, invariant, and consumer cases.
Applicable receipts are reused; changed inputs invalidate only affected proof.
Final gate is package-scoped rather than a blanket VibeVM run.

vision_mappings.requirement: Legacy behavior migrates losslessly into an explicit Rust epoch; known defects and prototype candidates are not blessed.
evidence_needs: Legacy corpus verifies exact codec, hash, newline, CAS, corrupt-tail, replay, and snapshot behavior.
New epoch distinguishes corrected closure behavior.
Temporary campaign facts and evidence are promoted before cleanup.

vision_mappings.requirement: The eight permanent specifications form one authority-preserving contract and actual registries remain capability truth.
evidence_needs: Spec links resolve and requirement map contains every fact ID.
Installed capability registry never promotes planned text to implemented behavior.

vision_mappings.requirement: The accepted Rust campaign proceeds to publication, then stops; NEXT and local Qwen inference remain prohibited.
evidence_needs: Campaign evidence shows zero NEXT dispatch and zero installed-local-Qwen invocation.
Published source-only payload is verified, then the ZAP campaign stops at R19.
